name: knock_over_cup_with_glass
doc: The glass is used to knock over the specified cup.
effect: The cup is knocked over by the glass.
code:
def run(arm, object, target, **_):
    # Get the current position of the object and target
    pos_object = arm.pos(object)
    pos_target = arm.pos(target)
    grasp_height = arm.top(object) - 0.02
    hover_height = grasp_height + 0.1
    
    # Open the gripper, approach above and grasp the object
    arm.open()
    arm.move_to([pos_object[0], pos_object[1], hover_height])
    arm.move_to([pos_object[0], pos_object[1], grasp_height])
    arm.grasp(object)

    # Calculate the position to tip the cup over
    tip_position = [pos_target[0] + 0.05, pos_target[1]]
    
    # Move the glass above the cup and lower it to the cup's height
    arm.move_to([tip_position[0], tip_position[1], hover_height + 0.05])
    arm.move_to([tip_position[0], tip_position[1], arm.top(target)])

    # Release the object
    arm.release()
    arm.move_to([pos_object[0], pos_object[1], hover_height])
    arm.home()

def check(before, after, object, target, **_):
    # Check if the target was tipped over
    return after["objects"][target]["tilt_deg"] > 45, f"{target} tipped over"
